data.name: Aquila 44 "My Way" - Coronado Captain Charter
data.headline: 3 - 6 hours
data.description: The ultimate small group sailing experience!
data.what_is_included:
The Aquila 44 is a pure bred power catamaran with a fresh evolution of classic boating traditions. Efficiency in design and performance compliment her luxurious living. She features 3 cabins, 3 heads, spacious salon and galley and extensive flybridge.
A US Coast Guard captain’s license is required for this vessel.
data.what_is_not_included: After hours and overnight rentals add on a 10% turnover fee to the final cost.
what_is_not_included_items: After hours and overnight rentals add on a 10% turnover fee to the final cost.
data.what_to_bring: Photo ID and credit card used for payment required for check in. Captain's fee is $100/hour + gratuity, paid directly to captain in cash
data.cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
data.cancellation_notes: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund. Once you are within 72 hours, no changes or cancellations are permitted. Failure to show for reservation still incurs full rental rate and is not eligible for a refund or reschedule. As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 72 hours in advance.
data.booking_notes:
##What to bring
Photo ID and credit card used for payment required for check in.

**If you are hiring a captain**  -- captain & crew who are available for hire charge $100/hour, plus gratuity, paid in cash directly to your captain.
data.disclaimers: Rates include all taxes, fees and fuel charges. The listed rate does not include the cost for a USCG Licensed captain to drive the boat for you. Per federal law we cannot select a captain for you, but would be happy to introduce you to a choice of local skippers who are qualified operate the boat. The hired captain will be paid directly at the time of the rental.
